author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Here is the post-AI workflow

1. User reports an issue in email or chat
2. AI agent start carry out first investigation 
- if the user is dumb, the AI politely tell them, they are dumb
- if it is a real bug, AI files a Jira ticket
3. Human tech lead look at the Jira ticket
- if it is a simple fix -> full auto AI
- if it is urgent -> sr. human engineer with his AI
- if it can wait -> jr. human engineer with his AI
